_comment: Example ~/.claude/settings.json registering pii-remover as a UserPromptSubmit hook. Generated by `pii-remover install --target claude-code` (see ADR-0012). Adjust the absolute path to where you installed the Bun-compiled binary.

_env_hint._PII_REMOVER_PROXY_TRUST: set to '1' to skip the localhost-URL check if a proxy is already running elsewhere (advanced, see ADR-0012 risks)
_env_hint._PII_REMOVER_BYPASS: set to '1' to disable masking entirely — NOT recommended; the hook will allow all prompts and the proxy will pass through unchanged
